fix(desktop): extend the macOS sidebar over the center panel inset

Code changes: +15 -0\
Tests: +0 -0\
Others: +0 -0

## What

On macOS, the open sidebar now covers the center panel's 6px left inset. The sidebar's right edge, its footer divider and the resize-hover line all sit on the panel border again.

## Why

#7509 gave the macOS center panel a fixed 6px left inset, so the panel does not jump when the sidebar opens or closes. That inset is sidebar-colored and sits beside the open sidebar. The result:

- The sidebar's right gutter looks 14px (8px + 6px), while its left gutter is 8px.
- The footer divider stops 6px short of the panel border.
- The resize-hover line draws 6px left of the panel border, inside the gap.

## Before / After

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| Footer divider ends 6px before the panel border; 14px gutter on the sidebar's right | Divider meets the panel border; 8px gutter on both sides |

Screenshots: _attached below_.

## How

One CSS rule in `styles.css`. On macOS outside native fullscreen, the open sidebar (`[data-slot="sidebar"][data-state="expanded"]`) gets `margin-right: -6px` (`--size-center-panel-inset-mac`). The panel moves under the sidebar's edge, and the sidebar keeps its width.

- The 6px frame inset stays, so the panel still never resizes. The margin transitions on the same 280ms curve the shell already uses to match the sidebar spring, so toggling has no 6px jump. Reduced motion skips the transition.
- The sidebar gap width and its Motion animation are unchanged. The titlebar collapse geometry, which reads the gap, and the resize drag seeding still see the real sidebar width.
- An earlier revision narrowed the gap with a `calc()` Motion target. Motion's measuring path for `calc()` stalled the collapse animation and failed `renderer-smoke`, so this PR replaced it.
- Windows, Linux and macOS fullscreen are unchanged.

## Testing

- Ran the desktop app from this branch on macOS (`npm run build:daemon -- --dev`, `electron-forge start`). The before/after captures come from the same window and data, with the change toggled through HMR.
- Local test, typecheck and lint suites were not run (owner's request). Relying on remote CI.

- [x] Branched from `main` (or continuing an existing PR branch)
- [x] One focused change; links the related issue when applicable
- [x] Follows [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator/blob/main/AGENTS.md) conventions and PR hygiene
- [ ] Before / After filled in; UI changes include screenshots or a recording
- [ ] Tests added/updated for user-visible behavior where it makes sense
- [ ] Relevant CI checks pass for the area touched (`go`, frontend, etc.)

fix(crossseed): add matches whose download name has no group

## Description

This fixes the add from search results when the tracker's listing has a group tag and the downloaded torrent's name has none. Search found the match, but the add stopped with "No matching torrents found with required files". The check that compares the download with the listing now ignores a missing group. A download that names another group, or that has another resolution or season, still fails the check.

Fixes #3697

**Merge danger:** two-way door, cross-seed

## Breaking change

No breaking change.

## Behaviour change

When search finds a match and the downloaded torrent's name has no group tag, qui now adds the cross-seed. Before, it stopped with "No matching torrents found with required files".

## How has this been tested?

I ran a local test setup with a qBittorrent 5.2.4 container and a mock Torznab indexer. The listing had a group tag, and the torrent that the indexer served had no group in its name. Through the API, I ran a search and then an apply on each build.

- This branch: the apply returned `success:true` with `status:"added"`.
- `develop` (c4a849cd1): the apply returned `status:"no_match"` with "No matching torrents found with required files". The log showed that the downloaded torrent did not read as the listing that search judged.

## Performance

No performance risk. The change adds one bitmask operation for each local torrent on a check that already runs. It adds no query, no request, and no loop.

## Checklist

- [x] My PR title follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/#summary) format (it becomes the squashed commit message)
- [ ] If this changes the database schema, I have added migrations for both SQLite and PostgreSQL
- [x] I completed the [mandatory performance checks](https://github.com/autobrr/qui/blob/develop/docs/agents/performance-checks.md) and recorded the outcome in Performance

fix(ai): harden Ollama stream completion and cancellation

## Summary

Fixes #61.

### Root cause

The Ollama streaming adapter treated a clean EOF as success even when the stream never delivered its terminal `done: true` event. It also classified read-time cancellation and deadline expiry as generic provider failures, and silently skipped malformed non-empty NDJSON events.

### Changes

- Require the final Ollama `done: true` event before returning success.
- Return `request_cancelled` and `request_timed_out` when the stream read is interrupted by the caller context.
- Reject malformed NDJSON events instead of silently discarding them.
- Keep Ollama-declared stream errors as provider failures.
- Add daemon-free Go tests for ordered successful chunks, clean premature EOF, malformed events, cancellation, deadline expiry and provider error events.

The changes are isolated to the AI provider adapter and its tests. They do not alter model selection, increase timeouts, or change the Shelf cache/translation UI.

### Translation-quality note

The unrelated and repeated Persian output in the report is a semantic-fidelity problem, not something transport handling can conclusively diagnose. Source/context integrity and reviewed semantic fixtures remain tracked by #56 and #58 / PR #60. This PR ensures interrupted Ollama output cannot be reported as a completed provider response.

### Validation

- Compared against current `main`: branch is 2 commits ahead and 0 commits behind.
- Added deterministic Go regression tests.
- Local `go test` could not be executed in this environment because outbound DNS/network access to GitHub is unavailable. CI checks on this PR must be used to confirm the tests and build.

fix: 深色主题首帧不再闪浅色

## Author

<!-- Select exactly one option. PRs created through the CLI or API must also follow this template. -->
- [ ] Human
- [x] Agent

## Type

<!-- Select exactly one option. Choose bug or feat for documentation, configuration, or dependency changes according to their purpose. -->
- [x] bug
- [ ] feat
- [ ] test

## Summary

**问题**：主题设为深色（或跟随系统、系统为深色）的用户，每次新开页面或刷新，都会先看到一帧浅色背景，然后才变成深色。应用脚本越慢，这一帧越长：冷缓存、发版后第一次打开时会持续几秒。用了非默认配色方案（ocean、forest 等）的用户，同样会先闪一帧默认配色。

**原因**：深色 class 和 `data-color-scheme` 是设置 store（`useColorMode`）初始化时才写到 `<html>` 上的，要等整个应用脚本下载、执行完。在此之前浏览器按默认的浅色变量绘制背景。Desktop 窗口在 `ready-to-show`（渲染进程第一次绘制）后才显示，而第一次绘制正是这帧浅色，所以 Desktop 也会闪。

**改动**：`apps/web/index.html` 和 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/index.html` 各加一段内联脚本，在首次绘制前读取设置 store 已保存的 `theme`、`color-scheme`，把深色 class 和配色方案写到 `<html>` 上。没有保存过主题时跟随系统，与 store 的默认值一致。应用启动后由 store 照常接管，主题切换逻辑不变。读取失败（例如禁用了存储）时保持原有行为。设置 store 里注明这两个 key 也会在启动前被读取。脚本放在 `<title>` 之前：桌面端避免与 #1653（删除字体外链）的改动相邻而冲突，网页端避免同步到下游时与 `<title>` 之后追加的标签冲突。

## Related Issues

Linear: [MEMOH-216](https://linear.app/felinic/issue/MEMOH-216)

## Validation

Agent 执行的检查：

- `vite build` 通过；改动的 ts 文件 eslint 通过；`check-ui-contract` 通过。
- 首帧逐帧对比：在独立的无头 Chromium 中，以已登录状态新开标签页，用 DevTools 录制每一帧，计算首帧平均亮度（0–255）。修复前用 `origin/main` 的 preview，修复后用本分支的 preview，后端都是 OSS dev 栈。

| 保存的主题 | 系统外观 | 修复前首帧 | 修复后首帧 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 深色 | 浅色 | 248（浅），之后变 6 | 6（深） |
| 跟随系统 | 深色 | 248（浅），之后变 6 | 6（深） |
| 深色 + ocean | 浅色 | 248（浅），之后变 6 | 6（深），启动后 `data-color-scheme=ocean` |
| 浅色 | 深色 | 248 | 248（不变） |
| 跟随系统 | 浅色 | 248 | 248（不变） |

所有情况下，应用启动后 `<html>` 的深色 class 和配色方案都与保存的偏好一致。

第 2 轮（head 178b7f148，只移动了脚本位置）：dev 环境中保存主题为深色，拦截应用入口脚本后打开页面，应用尚未挂载任何内容时 `<html>` 已带 `dark` class 和 `data-color-scheme=memoh`；内联脚本位于 `<title>` 之前。dev 模式下样式由应用脚本注入，这一步不能截出背景颜色，首帧截图仍以上表的 preview 对比为准。与 #1653 用 `git merge-tree` 试合并无冲突。

Desktop（Agent 执行，第 3 轮）：四个 PR 合在一起的临时构建，`electron-vite dev` 起 Electron 渲染进程，独立 userData，连本机 OSS dev 栈，经 CDP 驱动。保存主题为深色后重新加载渲染进程：解析到 `<body>` 时 `<html>` 已带 `dark` class，此时 `#app` 还没有任何子元素；应用启动后保持深色。dev 模式下样式由应用脚本注入，同样不能借此截出首帧背景色。连接页、登录页、聊天页在深色下显示正常。

未验证：

- 打包后的 Desktop 首帧（窗口 `ready-to-show` 那一帧）没有截图，只验证了 dev 构建里 class 写入的时机。
- 人工 QA：未做。

## Screenshots / Recordings

截图来自上述逐帧录制（无头 Chromium，1440×900，帧为 DevTools 缩略图）。

修复前：主题为深色，新开页面的第一帧是浅色背景，之后才切到深色。

![修复前：深色主题，第一帧是浅色背景](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0416d2b3-4bf6-4dc3-8eb0-1642ce88eb97)

修复后：主题为深色，第一帧就是深色背景，应用接管后保持深色。

![修复后：深色主题，第一帧就是深色](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/450fc2e0-4d8f-452c-b888-20dd145d4c6f)

修复后：深色 + ocean 配色，第一帧为深色。ocean 的深色背景与默认配色只有细微色相差，图上看不出区别；配色是否生效以表中启动后的 `data-color-scheme=ocean` 为准。

![修复后：深色 + ocean 配色，第一帧为深色](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ae7e7c44-6a76-47aa-b78f-a092cbda83cb)

修复后：浅色主题第一帧仍是浅色，行为不变。右图是应用渲染过程中的中间帧。

![修复后：浅色主题行为不变](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0fc12bcc-b359-4a19-b7f7-280dbead1c5e)

## Summary

**问题**：`fonts.googleapis.com` 慢或不回应时，Memoh 新开页面会一直空白，直到浏览器放弃这条请求。无代理访问 Google 的网络环境最可能遇到。

**原因**：`apps/web/index.html` 和 `apps/desktop/src/renderer/index.html` 的 `<head>` 引用了 Google Fonts 的 Inter 样式表（#598 引入）。外链样式表会阻塞渲染：浏览器拿到或放弃这份 CSS 之前不绘制页面。请求立即失败时没有影响；请求挂起时页面一直空白。

同一个 PR 也把 Inter 打包进了应用（`@fontsource-variable/inter`，在两个 `main.ts` 中引入）。字体栈 `--font-sans` 第一位就是打包的 `"Inter Variable"`，字符子集与 Google 版相同（latin、latin-ext、cyrillic、greek、vietnamese 及扩展），Google 版的 `"Inter"` 排第二，实际不会被用到。这条外链除了阻塞渲染没有别的作用。

**改动**：删除两个 `index.html` 中的 Google Fonts 样式表和两条 preconnect，共 6 行。不改字体栈和打包的字体。

**与 #1649 的关系**：#1649 在同两个 `index.html` 的 `<title>` 后加了脚本。Desktop 的文件里两处改动相邻，后合并的一个需要简单 rebase。

Agent 执行的检查：

- `vite build` 通过，构建产物 `index.html` 不再含 `fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com`。
- 实测：在独立的无头 Chromium 中以已登录状态新开标签页，用 DevTools 拦截 Google Fonts 请求，模拟可达和不回应两种情况，记录输入框出现的时间和页面实际使用的字体。修改后用本分支构建的 preview；修改前用同一份构建、把这 3 行加回 `index.html`，与 `origin/main` 的构建产物等价。后端都是 OSS dev 栈。

| | Google Fonts 可达 | Google Fonts 不回应 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 修改前 | 输入框 0.34s 出现；请求了 Google 样式表 1 次 | 30s 内页面没有绘制任何内容（测量上限 30s） |
| 修改后 | 输入框 0.39s 出现；没有请求 Google | 输入框 0.39s 出现；没有请求 Google |

- 所有出现输入框的情况下，正文字体都是 `"Inter Variable"` 且已加载；修改前即使 Google 可达，Google 版 `"Inter"` 加载的字形数也是 0，确认它没有被用到。
- 修改前后可达情况下的截图逐像素对比，唯一的差异是每次随机的欢迎语。

本地 1 次运行的结果，数值随机器和网络波动，用于说明"挂起与否"的差别，不代表线上耗时。

Desktop（Agent 执行，第 3 轮）：四个 PR 合在一起的临时构建，`electron-vite dev` 起 Electron 渲染进程，独立 userData，经 CDP 检查：整个启动、登录到聊天页的过程中没有发往 Google Fonts 的请求；`document.fonts` 中已加载的只有本地打包的 "Inter Variable"，界面文字按 Inter 显示。

未验证：

- 打包后的 Desktop 在 Google 挂起的网络下窗口是否按时出现，没有单独模拟；dev 构建中已确认不再发出这条请求。
- 无代理时 Google 实际是"立即失败"还是"挂起"没有实测；前者没有影响，后者就是表中的情况。

benchmarks.task_description:
fix(digests): stop a long Period from crashing winnow

Winnow loaded each stored Event of a Digest Period into memory before it counted them. A monthly Digest with 258,403 stored Events needed about 490 MiB of heap, so a pod with a 256 MiB memory limit crashed at each start. The store now gives the Events to `summarize` one at a time.

## Evidence

I copied a live store and replayed the October `autobrr-monthly` send under a 256 MiB cgroup memory limit:

| | Result | Heap | Digest message |
|---|---|---|---|
| v0.10.0 | killed, exit 137 | about 490 MiB with no limit | `70e2857a…` |
| this PR | sent | 11 MiB | `70e2857a…` (same SHA-256) |

**Merge danger:** two-way door, Digests only.

Genesis EU: sign OneApp/CCI auth calls with X-Fingerprint

This PR makes the Genesis EU password login work again.

It's been broken since the X-Fingerprint gate went live on Oct 14, on 0.318.1 it fails with:

```
login failed: cci token exchange failed: unexpected status: 400 (Bad Request) POST https://cci-api-eu.genesis.com/domain/api/v1/auth/token
```

#34906 added signing for Kia/Hyundai only, Genesis was left at "signing constants unknown". hyundai_kia_connect_api has them now (Hyundai-Kia-Connect/hyundai_kia_connect_api#1481), same scheme as the other two, client name `GenesisEU`. This PR adds them, plus the Genesis golden vector from the library's tests.

Tested with my G80 (EU account): password login and a forced token refresh both go through the signed route, no fallback to legacy. SoC and range come back.

Also fixed two test comments that still listed Genesis as a brand without CCI.
